title: Vampires Datapack
description: Adds vampires and the ability to become one
body:
# Vampires Datapack

A dark curse spreads through the world of Minecraft...

This datapack introduces Vampires into vanilla Minecraft, complete with infection mechanics, alchemy, supernatural abilities, and loyal vampire minions.

**Make sure to also download the required resourcepack**

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Be14_4IfGXg" title="YouTube-Videoplayer" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
---

## Vampires
- Bats can secretly be vampires waiting to attack
- Getting attacked by a vampire can infect you with vampirism
- Become a powerful creature of the night
- Unique vampire abilities and mechanics
- Fully survival-friendly gameplay integration

## Bat Transformation
- Transform yourself into a bat
- Fly through the night with ease
- Perfect for exploration and stealth
- Smooth transformation mechanics

## Alchemy System
- Brew powerful vampire-related potions
- Discover forbidden recipes
- Create special ingredients and mixtures
- Expand your vampire abilities through alchemy

## Vampire Sword
- Brand new custom weapon
- Designed specifically for vampire combat
- Unique visuals and mechanics
- Craftable in survival

## Vampire Minions
- Turn villagers into your loyal servants
- Build your own network of vampire followers
- Command your growing vampire influence
- Spread the curse across villages

## Survival Friendly
- Fully integrated crafting recipes
- Multiplayer compatible
- Vanilla-style visuals and mechanics
- Designed to feel like an official Minecraft feature
